reviews.title: It’s ok…. But too many ads
reviews.text: I’ve had it for a little time and enjoyed it, but after every photo it’s an add.  I don’t want it  to a point when I don’t even want to take a photo on this app. It’s jst the ads.

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text:
Text colour is unreadable, it has too much going on. The pro analogue pack was non existent in the promotion.

The app should be simple to use, yet it was more complicated than the real thing.
